message.content:
**UNO – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you’ll do | |---------|----------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score ≥ 500 points across one or more games. Points come from opponents’ remaining cards when someone goes “UNO.” | | **Deck** | Standard UNO set: 108 cards—
• 25× each color (Red/Yellow/Green/Blue) with numbers 0–9 and two action cards per color.
• 8 *Draw Two*, 8 *Reverse*, 8 *Skip*.
• 4 *Wild* + 4 *Wild Draw Four*. | --- ### Setup 1. Shuffle all 108 cards thoroughly. 2. Deal **7 cards** face down to each player. Keep your hand hidden. 3. Flip the top card of the draw pile onto the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately before play starts. - *If it's a Wild or Wild Draw Four*: choose a starting colour and treat as if it were a normal wild card. - *If it's Skip / Reverse / Draw Two*: apply normally (e.g., skip the next player). 4. Place the rest of the deck facedown beside the discard pile → this becomes the **draw pile**. 5. Decide who plays first (usually the person left of dealer). --- ### Turn Overview On your turn you may: 1. **Play a matching card** (by colour, number, or symbol) on top of the current discard. 2. Or, if no match exists, **play a Wild/Wild Draw Four** at any time. 3. After playing a card, you may optionally place another playable card from your hand (this rule is optional in many house variants). 4. If you cannot play anything, you must **draw one card** from the draw pile. - If that drawn card matches, you may play it immediately. - Otherwise, end your turn. After completing your move, announce **“UNO”** if you have exactly one card left. Failure to say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn results in a penalty: you must pick up two extra cards. --- ### Action Cards & Their Effects | Card | Effect When Played | |------|--------------------| | **Skip** | Next player loses his/her turn. | | **Reverse** | Order of play reverses direction (clockwise ↔ counter‑clockwise). In a 2‑player game, Reverse acts like Skip. | | **Draw Two (+2)** | Next player draws two cards AND misses their turn. | | **Wild** | You declare which colour will continue the round. | | **Wild Draw Four (+4)** | Same as Wild, plus the next player must draw four cards unless they challenge. See Challenge below. | #### Challenging a Wild Draw Four Only allowed if the previous player could not legally play a non‑wild card of the declared colour. To challenge: 1. Opponent says “Challenge!” before drawing the four cards. 2. All players reveal their hands. 3. If the challenger had a legal coloured card, the challenger picks up six cards total (the original four + two additional penalties). 4. If the challenger was correct (no such card existed), the challenged player keeps the four cards and the challenger draws six instead. *(House rules vary; some people forbid challenges entirely.)* --- ### Winning a Round When a player discards their last card: 1. That player scores points equal to the sum of values of all other players’ remaining cards: - Numbered cards count as their numeric value. - Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 pts each. - Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 pts each. 2. Add those points to the winner’s cumulative score. 3. Start a new round: reshuffle discarded cards into a fresh deck, deal again, flip a new start card, and repeat until somebody reaches ≥ 500 points. --- ### Common House Variations | Variation | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack multiple Draw Twos or Draw Fours on top of each other, forcing the next opponent to accumulate the total penalty rather than drawing once. | | **No Extra Play** | Some groups allow only one card per turn (except during a challenge). | | **Instant Win** | First player to reach 200+ points wins instantly. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (Star Wars, Pokémon, etc.). Just keep the same structure of colours/symbols. | Feel free to tweak any rule to suit your group! Enjoy the fast‑paced fun of UNO.
